name: Scatter Scree
body:
School conjuration [earth]; Level druid/shaman 0, magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of gravel)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Area two contiguous 5-foot squares
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial, see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You call toss the bit of scree up into the air summoning a rain of gravel in the designated areas. Any creatures in the area take 1d3 non-magical bludgeoning damage. A successful Reflex save reduces this damage to 1, creatures with evasion/improved evasion can negate this altogether. The ground in the affected areas become difficult terrain. A creature can use a standard action to clear the difficult terrain from a square.

If you cast the spell again, any previous difficult terrain you created disappears as you conjure the same pile of gravel.
